title: How I Met Everyone Else
cn: 第 5 集 · 我如何遇见每个人
novel:
Ted's new girlfriend wanted to know how the group [[formed|form]]. Each member told their [[origin|origin]] story with [[flashbacks|flashback]] that [[revealed|reveal]] forgotten memories.

Marshall [[recalled|recall]] meeting Ted in their college [[dormitory|dormitory]]. Ted had been carrying a [[stack|stack]] of architecture books. They [[bonded|bond]] over pizza and dreams.

Lily [[remembered|remember]] meeting Marshall in a hallway. She had [[dropped|drop]] her [[sketchbook|sketchbook]], and he had [[picked|pick]] it up. It was a [[coincidence|coincidence]] that felt like [[destiny|destiny]].

Barney [[claimed|claim]] he had met Ted in a bathroom. Ted [[denied|deny]] this, but Barney [[insisted|insist]].

Robin's story was simplest: she had walked into MacLaren's one rainy night and never left. As the stories [[intertwined|intertwine]], Ted's girlfriend smiled. She [[realized|realize]] this group was a family built on a thousand small [[coincidences|coincidence]].

form.en: to come together as a group

destiny.en: things that will happen to you

deny.en: to say something is not true

insist.en: to say firmly something is true
